title: Structured Tracing and Stable Workflows
summary: LangChain.js lands structured tool argument tracing while n8n patches critical instance key encryption bugs in stable.
thesis: Agent runtimes solidify structured tracing boundaries.

items.name: langchainjs
items.what: Preserves structured tool arguments directly in tracer run inputs.
items.whyDifferent: Ensures downstream observers inspect exact payloads without serialisation loss.

items.name: n8n
items.what: Repairs data-encryption keys stored as raw instance keys and sweeps parked sub-execution parents.
items.whyDifferent: Secures multi-tenant instance key handling and prevents dangling sub-workflow deadlocks.

readThrough: Agent instrumentation requires precise payload visibility. These updates ensure that tracing systems retain structured tool inputs and workflow engines preserve encryption integrity under load; teams should evaluate it against their own stack, security controls and operating constraints before adoption.

social.linkedin: Agent runtimes solidify structured tracing boundaries. LangChain.js version @langchain/core@1.2.12 preserves structured tool arguments in tracer run inputs, ensuring downstream observability platforms inspect exact payloads without format loss. Meanwhile, n8n stable 2.39.8 fixes data-encryption keys stored as raw instance keys and resolves sub-execution sweep leaks. Engineering teams building agentic loops rely on exact audit trails and secure instance state; these updates address silent telemetry gaps and key management risks across distributed node environments.
